G2_evidence_grounding.rationale: Refinement output (754 paragraphs from 7 docs) all carry source IDs and paragraph anchors; both professor packs cite evidence quotes with document IDs. However, the corpus itself is too narrow: zero country-level negotiation positions means no stance triples can be evidenced yet. Evidence_quote chain is intact for what exists, but the empirical base is missing.
G2_evidence_grounding.blocker: Same as G1 — without UNFCCC submissions, no country×issue stance evidence.

G3_theory_grounding.rationale: Two professors evaluated theory grounding. IR-Political: 3.5/5 (IR canon citations adequate; paradigm balance lacking — realism/constructivism explicitly excluded). Policy-Sci: 3.0/5 (IR theory present but policy-science core — instrument theory, MLG, implementation gap, policy transfer — absent). Mean 3.25/5 = 0.65. Specific gaps documented: NATO 4-axis instrument typology, frame_type variable, salience asymmetry, chairmanship procedural power, realist null model — none currently in CINA framework.
G3_theory_grounding.remediation: Round 2 schema v1.3 absorbs CR1 (instrument + frame + salience). Round 3 absorbs CR2 (chair power) into Stage 2 graph. Realist B0 baseline added to evaluation Round 3.

G4_dual_review.rationale: Dual review completed by both professors. Mean rubric: Policy-Sci 2.8/5, IR-Political 3.3/5. Policy-Sci is below the council-protocol threshold of 3/5 (= 0.60), but only by 0.04. IR clears. Aggregated mean (3.05/5 = 0.61) clears the threshold marginally. Productive disagreement on 5 issues documented in cross_review.md §3 with assigned resolutions. No reviewer recommended reject; both recommended major revision tied to Round 2-3 deliverables.
G4_dual_review.blocker: Policy-Sci rubric below threshold driven by Empirical 2/5 + Policy-relevance 2/5 — both will rise once data corpus expands and Korean-ministry cross-walk added.
G4_dual_review.remediation: Round 2: schema v1.3 + collector matrix; Round 3: re-evaluate with both professors after refinement.

G5_heedo_alignment.rationale: All Round 1 work adheres to four constitutional directives: (1) publishable-grade methodology (infrastructure-level standards: sha256, license tracking, identifier registry, prompt versioning); (2) COP30 Belém Adaptation Indicators retrospective validation as primary case (all professor critiques anchor to this); (3) dual-track preserved (deliverables/ vs docs/ untouched); (4) LLM-GNN-LLM novelty intact (Stage 1 schema enrichment, Stage 2 graph variables, Stage 3 briefing all advanced, none replaced). Productive disagreements between professors do not threaten the constitution; cross_review.md §5 verifies all proposed enrichments are constitution-aligned.

round_1_close_rationale: G5 pass + G3/G4 partial pass + G1/G2 fail with clear remediation path. Two-professor consensus that Round 1 is foundational, not validation. Closing Round 1 now allows Round 2 to focus on (i) Playwright collection + matrix CR5 (70-100 docs), (ii) schema v1.3 (instrument + frame + salience), (iii) chair_status + pen_holder + drafts_text variables. No constitutional violation detected; Heedo escalation needed only on D1 (scope expansion to implementation cycle) and infrastructure approvals (Playwright binary, ENB academic contact).
